zh-CN.summary: Monet 2.3.0 会话内感知 Claude 额度并可在 5 小时额度恢复后自动续跑，实时显示 CLI 状态，修复运行中切换权限模式；同时带来档案标签、Worktree 会话聚合、项目文件引用与多项 Codex、Windows 修复。

items.title: 额度感知与自动续跑
items.detail: 会话内提示 5 小时额度接近上限或已用完；开启续跑后，额度恢复时自动发送“继续”，计划在重启后保留，手动发送消息即取消。

items.title: CLI 实时状态
items.detail: 会话中显示 API 重试、上下文压缩、模型降级与工具权限被拒；CLI 启动时报告的插件与 MCP 问题也会给出提示。

items.title: 档案标签与星标管理
items.detail: 支持编辑会话标题、筛选星标会话，以及跨引擎设置标签颜色、重命名、合并和删除标签。

items.title: Worktree 会话聚合
items.detail: 同一仓库的 Worktree 会话集中展示，并标明来源与分支；原工作区删除后仍可查看历史，支持的引擎可在主目录续写。

items.title: 在输入框引用项目文件
items.detail: 支持文件和目录路径补全，发送前校验引用是否有效，并在编辑排队输入时保留引用。

items.title: 命令与模型以 CLI 为准
items.detail: 斜杠命令补全纳入 CLI 报告的命令，模型列表采用 CLI 报告的可用模型。

items.title: 额度面板少轮询
items.detail: 会话收到实时额度后，额度面板与菜单栏优先使用这份数据，减少对额度接口的请求。

items.title: Claude 协议诊断
items.detail: 引擎设置页显示已验证的 CLI 版本，以及 Monet 尚未识别的协议消息样本。

items.title: Codex Computer Use 运行时检查
items.detail: 设置页显示插件与本地服务的兼容状态；运行时组件更新后，在下一轮任务前重新连接。

items.title: Windows Nightly 安装包
items.detail: Nightly 现提供与 macOS 同版本的 Windows 安装包，双平台工件与更新清单验证通过后统一发布。

items.title: 运行中切换权限模式
items.detail: 切换会立即发送给运行中的 CLI，确认成功后才更新界面；被拒绝或超时时回退到实际模式并提示。

items.title: CLI 交互请求不再卡住会话
items.detail: Monet 暂不支持的 CLI 请求会被回绝并在会话内提示，任务继续执行。

items.title: 自定义 Codex CLI 路径与 Windows 检测
items.detail: 支持选择 Codex 可执行文件或安装目录，并修复 Windows 上通过 npm 安装的 CLI 检测。

items.title: 中断后的 Codex 提问顺序
items.detail: 立即中断的提问会保留在原来的时间线位置，避免被后续轮次挤到错误位置。

items.title: 图片加载对 Codex 任务的干扰
items.detail: 限制并发资源加载，并保护正在执行的轮次，避免历史图片读取干扰当前任务。

items.title: Claude 额度凭据续期
items.detail: 凭据过期时委托官方 Claude Code CLI 续期，并改进失败提示与重试退避。

items.title: Windows 工作区 Git 探测弹窗
items.detail: 后台检查工作区和分支信息时隐藏 Git 控制台，避免反复弹出命令行窗口。

en-US.summary: Monet 2.3.0 tracks Claude rate limits and can continue after the 5-hour limit resets, shows live CLI status, and fixes mid-run permission switching. Also: archive tags, Worktree grouping, file references, and Codex and Windows fixes.

items.title: Rate-limit awareness and auto-continue
items.detail: Sessions warn when the 5-hour limit is close or reached. With auto-continue on, Monet sends "continue" once the limit resets; the plan survives restarts and is cancelled when you send a message yourself.

items.title: Live CLI status
items.detail: Sessions show API retries, context compaction, model fallback, and denied tool permissions, plus plugin and MCP problems the CLI reports at startup.

items.title: Archive tags and stars
items.detail: Edit session titles, filter starred sessions, and manage tag colors, renaming, merging, and deletion across engines.

items.title: Worktree session grouping
items.detail: Browse a repository's Worktree sessions together with source and branch labels. History remains readable after a workspace is deleted; supported engines can continue in the main directory.

items.title: Project file references in composers
items.detail: Complete file and directory paths, validate references before sending, and preserve them when editing queued input.

items.title: Commands and models from the CLI
items.detail: Slash-command completion includes commands the CLI reports, and the model list uses the models the CLI makes available.

items.title: Less quota polling
items.detail: Once a session receives live rate-limit data, the quota panel and menu bar use it first and query the quota endpoint less often.

items.title: Claude protocol diagnostics
items.detail: Engine settings show the verified CLI version and samples of protocol messages Monet does not yet recognize.

items.title: Codex Computer Use runtime checks
items.detail: Settings shows plugin and local-service compatibility. Updated runtime components reconnect before the next task turn.

items.title: Windows Nightly installers
items.detail: Nightly now includes Windows installers matching the macOS version, with both platforms' artifacts and updater metadata verified before publication.

items.title: Switching permission mode mid-run
items.detail: Changes are sent to the running CLI immediately and the UI updates only after the CLI confirms; a rejection or timeout restores the actual mode with a notice.

items.title: CLI interactive requests no longer stall sessions
items.detail: CLI requests Monet does not support yet are declined with a notice in the session, and the task keeps running.

items.title: Custom Codex CLI paths and Windows discovery
items.detail: Select a Codex executable or installation directory, with corrected discovery of npm-installed CLI versions on Windows.

items.title: Interrupted Codex prompt ordering
items.detail: Immediately interrupted prompts stay anchored in their original timeline position instead of moving after later turns.

items.title: Image loading during Codex tasks
items.detail: Limits concurrent asset requests and protects active turns so historical image loading does not interfere with the current task.

items.title: Claude quota credential renewal
items.detail: Delegates expired credential renewal to the official Claude Code CLI and improves failure messages and retry backoff.

items.title: Windows workspace Git console popups
items.detail: Hides Git consoles during background workspace and branch probes to prevent repeated command-window popups.
